<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def bb(fr):
    out={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','M','c','N'):

    return out
print('start:', bb(current_frame))

</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
